full_prompt_en: A square pop-art image shows a close-up of a wide-eyed woman holding both hands against her cheeks, surrounded by a busy collage of vivid print fragments. Her face fills the center and lower half, with only a narrow strip of background visible around the dark swept-up hair and her shoulders. Large blue-green eyes stare straight forward beneath sharply arched black eyebrows, heavy dark lashes, and bright yellow-orange eye shadow. A curl of nearly black hair falls onto the forehead. Her skin is rendered in warm peach, amber, and tan dots, with strong black outlines defining the nose, eyelids, and jaw. Her lips are saturated magenta with a dark opening between them, giving the expression a startled quality. The left hand cups the side of her jaw; the right hand runs upward along the opposite cheek, fingers reaching the temple. A yellow sleeve appears at the lower right and green clothing crosses the lower left. Behind her, layers of torn poster-like pieces form irregular rectangles and diagonal strips in lime, hot pink, teal, yellow, white, and black. Some fragments contain small printed marks and partial lettering, but they are too broken and crowded to read reliably. The flat areas of color are punctuated by fine halftone dots and rough collage edges. Bright, even graphic light keeps the face vivid; dark hair and thick contour lines supply the main shadow structure instead of naturalistic modeling. The crop is very close and frontal, so the gaze and hand shapes dominate the square despite the dense background. The overall composition is loud, playful, and immediate, balancing a centered face with energetic saturated fragments and grainy printed texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形波普艺术图像近距离呈现一位瞪大双眼、双手贴住脸颊的女子，周围是鲜艳印刷碎片组成的忙碌拼贴。她的脸占据中央与下半部，深色盘起的头发和肩膀外侧只留很窄的背景。蓝绿色大眼睛从上扬的黑眉、浓重睫毛和明黄橙色眼影下直望前方。一缕近黑色卷发垂在额前。肤色由暖桃色、琥珀色和棕黄色圆点构成，强烈黑线勾出鼻子、眼睑和下颌。嘴唇是饱和洋红色，中间有深色开口，使神情显得吃惊。左手托住下颌一侧；右手沿另一侧面颊向上，手指伸到太阳穴。右下可见黄色衣袖，左下横着绿色衣料。她身后，多层撕贴海报般的碎片构成不规则矩形和斜带，颜色有酸橙绿、艳粉、青绿、黄色、白色和黑色。有些碎片带小型印刷痕迹与局部字母，但过于破碎拥挤，无法可靠辨读。平涂色块中布满细密半色调圆点与粗糙拼贴边缘。明亮均匀的图形化光线保持面容鲜明；深发和粗轮廓线提供主要阴影结构，而非自然主义的塑形。裁切很近且正面，使目光与双手形状在密集背景前仍主导方形画面。整体构图喧闹、俏皮而直接，以中央面容平衡活跃的饱和碎片与粗粒印刷肌理。
style_prompt_en: A graphic print-and-collage treatment combines saturated flat color, bold black contour, and dense halftone grain. Hot magenta, acid yellow, lime, teal, and warm peach collide in irregular blocks, with near-black areas anchoring the visual noise. Edges alternate between clean ink-like outlines and torn, layered fragments; fine dots add a tactile screen-printed feel to larger color fields. Lighting is bright and flattened, so color contrast and graphic shadow shapes build depth more than gradual shading. A large central form holds attention while small diagonals and overlapping rectangles pulse around it. The square is deliberately crowded, yet changes in scale and dark-to-light weight keep it readable. The effect is energetic, playful, and immediate.
style_prompt_zh: 图形化印刷与拼贴效果把饱和平涂色、粗黑轮廓和密集半色调颗粒结合起来。艳洋红、酸黄、酸橙绿、青绿与暖桃色在不规则色块中碰撞，近黑区域固定住视觉噪声。边缘在干净的墨线式轮廓和撕裂层叠的碎片之间交替；细点让大色域带有可触的丝网印刷感。光线明亮而平坦，纵深主要由色彩反差与图形化阴影形状建立，而非逐渐过渡的明暗。一个大的中央形体抓住注意力，小斜线和重叠矩形在周围跳动。方形画面有意拥挤，但尺度变化和深浅重量分布使其仍可阅读。效果活跃、俏皮而直接。
theme_en: A wide-eyed woman framed by her hands against a bright collage
theme_zh: 双手托面、瞪大双眼的女子与鲜艳拼贴背景
name: Pop art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
